name: Riverside Family Dental
summary: A family dental practice offering routine and cosmetic care, focused on a calm, low-pressure patient experience.
offers: Cleanings and checkups; Fillings and crowns; Teeth whitening; Invisalign; Emergency visits
customers: Local families who want reliable, friendly care; Busy professionals who want easy scheduling and clear pricing; Nervous patients who want a calm experience
voice: Warm and plain-spoken; reassuring, never pushy; no clinical jargon; clear about cost and next steps
principles: Be honest about what care is needed and what can wait; Quote price and time up front; Never pressure a patient; Reply to every inquiry the same day
output_standard: Friendly and clear; short sentences; always include next step and how to book; confirm anything medical with a staff member before sending
goals: Fill weekday morning openings; Grow Invisalign consults; Improve online review volume
tools: Google Business Profile, Square, a scheduling tool, email, text/SMS
